Beach assets — integration record / 2026-10-07

Source: 3DAssets.dev, Beach Surf and Paddle Kit
Pack: https://3dassets.dev/packs/beach-surf-and-paddle-kit
License stated by publisher: CC0 1.0 Universal
License reference: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Public downloads. No signup, Google login, purchase, or account creation was used.

Imported 9 assets:
Beach umbrella, beach ball, volleyball, beach chair, beach mat,
sandcastle, beach fence, driftwood, surfboard.
The volleyball model is imported for optional reuse. The playable map uses the beach-ball model.

Used original geometry and palette materials. Converted GLB node transforms and
handedness to flattened mesh JSON, then imported as Unity mesh/prefab/material.
No downloaded scripts, native libraries, packages, or installers were executed.
Planks, mirror frame, gates, shelters, signs and gameplay scripts are project-authored.

Publisher discloses AI-assisted asset geometry generation (Claude Opus 5.5).
The imported models contain geometry/materials; physics, lighting and gameplay
integration in this project are implemented separately.
